route: The existing specialized integral relation has an explicit full multiset of p+1 distinct Laurent roots. Identify its monic prime relation with the existing modularPolynomial, transfer separability through the rational-function coordinate at a transcendental j, and combine its root cardinality with the already proved p+1 cyclic-subgroup count and surjective actual root map. This should prove the required generic-fiber injectivity without developing all positive-characteristic elliptic endomorphisms.
scope: The proposed injectivity theorem is for the required transcendental generic j-fiber. It does not assert injectivity at CM exceptional fibers or at every algebraic non-CM j. The precise generic-curve application must derive the transcendence condition.
status: Reuse assessment only. Separability transfer and generic-fiber bijection still require Lean proofs.
